'''Shannon''' (Japanese: '''ショウブ''' ''Shōbu'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW100|A Village Homecoming!]]''. She is a resident of the [[Village of Dragons]] and a childhood friend of {{an|Iris}} as well as a {{tc|Pokémon Breeder}}.

Shannon first greeted {{an|Iris}}, {{Ash}}, and {{an|Cilan}} when {{ashfr|the trio}} came to the Village of Dragons for a visit. She explained that she was entrusted with the care of two {{p|Zweilous}}, who were close as they hatched from their eggs on the same day, and invited the three for a visit at her house. When the three met up with her after visiting {{OBP|elder|Village of Dragons}}, she revealed that she had dreams of leaving the Village of Dragons and traveling like Iris, but felt that she couldn't abandon the Pokémon she was raising. Iris, however, prompted her to shed her nervousness and ask the {{OBP|elder|Village of Dragons}} about it.

Later, when one of the Zweilous evolved into {{p|Hydreigon}} and Iris took the task of calming the {{pkmn|category|Brutal Pokémon}} upon herself, she was seen visibly worried for the young Dragon Master. When Hydreigon was calmed down, thanks to the efforts of Iris and her Pokémon, Shannon asked the elder if she could go on a journey once the second Zweilous evolved. The elder agreed, telling Shannon that she only needed to ask.

She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[BW101|Drayden Versus Iris: Past, Present, and Future!]]''.
